records.text: Candace Owens recalled that Rush Limbaugh was the person Charlie Kirk adored most, that Kirk never expected to meet him, and that Kirk had been raised listening to Limbaugh
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: The person that he adored the most—like, really, never in a million years did he think that he was going to meet him, and of course he did—was Rush Limbaugh. ... He was really raised on Rush Limbaugh, listening to Rush Limbaugh day in and day out, and he told me through many conversations that if he could have a show like Rush Limbaugh one day, he would be very happy. ... That was, I think, his ultimate goal, and it happened.

verification.notes: Verified as a first-person attribution claim: Owens’s primary memorial recording contains the recollection exactly. Kirk’s own 2021 essay independently confirms Limbaugh’s formative influence and recounts their first meeting and friendship. The superlative “adored most” and Kirk’s expectations are explicitly presented as Owens’s personal recollection, not an independently measurable ranking.
